heading: INT. UNDERSEA CORAL CATHEDRAL - THRONE HALL - DUSK

units.text: INT. UNDERSEA CORAL CATHEDRAL - THRONE HALL - DUSK
Arches of living coral rise into green gloom.
Shafts of light pass through a ceiling of slow, shimmering water.
Schools of silver fish loop through pillars like banners in a wind.
The air, impossibly, is breathable, but everything moves as if underwater: hair, robes, flame.
EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY, 80s, ancient and translucent as a jellyfish, sits on a throne grown from pale branching coral.
Her robes drift.
At her right stands ADMIRAL CORVIN HASK, 50s, scarred, armored in abalone plates.
At her left, the young priestess SELENE OKONKWO-REYES, 20s, clutches a conch shell.
At the foot of the dais, a boy, TIDE, 10, sits cross-legged with a dented tin whistle.
The tide has turned. I feel it in my bones.
units.name: EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY

units.text: The fleet awaits your word.
units.name: ADMIRAL HASK

units.text: There is no fleet, Admiral. There are seven ships and four are leaking.
units.name: SELENE

units.text: Then three.
units.name: ADMIRAL HASK

units.text: The conch glows in Selene's hands.
Tide blows a soft note on the whistle.
A crab scuttles across the floor.
Selene, what does the shell say?
units.name: EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY

units.text: It says the surface is coming down.
units.name: SELENE

units.text: The surface has always been coming down.
units.name: ADMIRAL HASK

units.text: Not like this.
units.name: SELENE

units.text: A VOICE from deep within the walls, vast and slow, rolls through the hall.
Empress. The debt is due.
units.name: THE DEEP

units.text: The fish scatter.
The light dims.
Hask draws a trident.
Thalassa-Vey lifts one hand, and the water stills.
Tide stops playing.
I know.
units.name: EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY

units.text: She rises, slowly, and her robes billow out like a sail.
She steps down from the throne, past Hask, past Selene, and kneels in front of the boy.
Takes the whistle gently from his hands.
Child, you will play for me.
units.name: EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY

units.text: What song?
units.name: TIDE

units.text: The last one. The one your mother taught you.
units.name: EMPRESS THALASSA-VEY

units.text: Tide takes a breath and begins, small and thin.
Hask lowers the trident.
Selene lowers the shell.
Above them, the sunlight goes out, one ray at a time.
